name: Garment in a light breeze
summary: The fabric moves softly while the camera drifts to one side.
outcome: Your garment with its fabric moving softly, as if in a light breeze, while the camera drifts slowly to one side.
photoGuidance: A photo of one garment on a rail, a mannequin or a model.
The whole garment in frame, sharp and well lit.
limitations: Faces and hands can change if a model is in the photo.
Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: The garment
inputs.help: For example, 'linen abaya in sand' or 'navy wool coat'.

options.label: Subtle
options.prompt: The fabric moves very slightly, as in still indoor air.

options.label: Light breeze
options.prompt: The fabric moves softly, as in a light breeze.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject}.
prompt.composition: The garment stays whole and centred in the frame.
prompt.environment: The background stays as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera drifts slowly and steadily to one side.
prompt.lighting: Soft, even studio light that shows the texture of the fabric.
prompt.mood: Clean and considered, like a lookbook.
